_about: Human-reviewed decisions about person identities. Built by reviewing every candidate pair produced by step2_person_candidates.py against the report text.
Member status: 'confirmed' = a report states the link; 'likely' = name variant whose context is consistent (merged); the first member of each group is the display name.
'possible' links are NOT merged. They are kept so the GUI can show them as suggestions for the analyst to judge.
'source': 'algorithm' = suggested by step2_person_candidates.py; 'manual' = found during review.
